evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: about 14 diagonal blue and olive bands separated by cream gaps, with pitch denser at the right and sparser at the left; by shot-20s the same banding mirrors into a chevron about the centre line.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one flat 2D band field with a domain warp that bends the stripes; shot-20s adds a mirrored copy and two overlapping rectangles, but there is no simulation, lighting or material layer.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: stair-stepped aliasing along every blue and olive band edge at full size; by shot-20s small notches show where the two rectangles meet near the top and bottom of the centre seam.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: indigo, olive and cream striped bands, unlike the apricot grain of 2026-11-26, the coral, the dendrite and the Penrose kites; no recent night shows a striped cloth.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: a near-empty indigo rectangle with a thin sliver at the left, composed but sparse; by shot-20s the mirrored chevron fills the frame and resolves cleanly on the cream ground.

pairwise_justification: Shot-08s blue and olive stripes read as one clear graphic; the median's apricot grain square is noisier and monochrome, so tonight wins the head-to-head vote.

critique.change: Supersample or antialias the band edges so blue and olive stripes stop stair-stepping at full size, and blend the two rectangles where they meet at the centre seam so no notch shows at shot-20s.

Start shot-02s with three or four bands already pushed in along the diagonal instead of one flat rectangle and a sliver, so the first frame already shows the wrap rule and reads as composed from the start.
Shade each compressed band with a darker fold crease and light falloff so the stripes read as gathered cloth, not flat ink; this adds a rendering idea the 8s and 20s frames currently lack.
